description: Default limits for Basileus. A run may tighten these (doctrine, task prompt) but never loosen them without the player saying so in chat.
forbidden: attack, pillage, occupy, blockade or any military/naval mission
trading with other players, market offers, the Premium Trader
spending Ambrosia or anything bought with real money (speed-ups, premium features)
demolishing buildings, abandoning or founding towns
research, government changes, diplomacy, messages, alliance actions
account settings, logging in or typing any password, solving captchas
stopConditions: captcha or bot check of any kind
unexpected dialog or page the playbook does not describe
game state does not match the step's precondition (skip that step, continue others)
Claude in Chrome not connected (end the run, notify)
